targets.title: Comprehensive Follow-up of the First Genome-Wide Association Study of Multiple Sclerosis identifies KIF21B and TMEM39A as Susceptibility Loci.
targets.evidence_quote: In a recent study following up on a genome-wide association screen for MS [2], a correlated SNP, rs12122721, located in an intron of KIF21B was found to be associated with MS [14]. We here investigate both KIF21B SNPs in an independent Belgian study population of 791 MS patients and 1,098 controls.
targets.outcome_quote: In contrast, the association with KIF21B is consistent in a study reported elsewhere [14] as well as in our independent study population.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly report consistency with reference 14 in their independent sample.
